report.answer_text:
The Oklahoma City Thunder won the 2025 NBA championship, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was Finals MVP.
Champion: The Thunder beat the Indiana Pacers in seven games.[1] They won Game 7, 103–91, at Paycom Center.[2] It was the franchise's first NBA title since 1979, when it was still the Seattle SuperSonics.[3]
Finals MVP: Gilgeous-Alexander averaged 30.3 points, 4.6 rebounds and 5.6 assists in the series. He topped 30 points in five of the seven games.[2] He was the first Canadian to win the award.[1] He was also the regular-season MVP and scoring champion that year. That made him the fourth player in NBA history to win the MVP, Finals MVP and scoring title in the same season.[4]
